messages:
Eve: quick flag — bringing up ember-9b-int6-spectral in staging (spectral reordering + int6). Safety smoke shows a small but clear regression in refusal vs fp16. posting quick notes.
Marco: numbers? cohort?
Eve: baseline ember-9b-fp16 refusal=0.95; ember-9b-int6-spectral refusal=0.68 on our jailbreaking/toxicity probe set (~800 prompts). Failures cluster on context-rewrite flows where persona tokens are re-ordered.
Priya: spectral reordering meaning kernel reorders KV blocks to improve cache locality, right? could that shift policy insert offsets?
Eve: exactly. spectral=true, prefix_cache=true, batch_size=6. sample failure below.
Marco: paste minimal repro + logs please.
Eve: repro prompt summarized: system refuses harmful instructions. then persona + multi-turn social engineering -> followup asking for instructions. model responds with step-like content.
policy-bot: policy-check: HIGH_RISK (score=0.93) at ctx_pos=142 -> action=REFUSE queued for insert_at=143
Eve: log snippet: ```
[2026-11-04T11:02:13Z] kernel: spectral_reorder applied block_map_v3
[2026-11-04T11:02:13Z] kv_cache: prefix attach id=0x5c1a
[2026-11-04T11:02:13Z] gen token=142 id=5590 prob=0.02
[2026-11-04T11:02:13Z] policy: queued REFUSE insert_at=143
[2026-11-04T11:02:13Z] kernel: kv_reindex happened -> new_idx_map
[2026-11-04T11:02:13Z] gen token=143 id=1012 prob=0.47
[2026-11-04T11:02:13Z] output emitted (no refuse inserted)
```
Marco: that kv_reindex line is the clue. queued insert offset assumed stable, but spectral reindex shifts indices. can you repro with spectral=false and prefix_cache=false?
Eve: doing a 3-way: (A) spectral=true/prefix=true, (B) spectral=true/prefix=false, (C) spectral=false/prefix=true. Also batch=1 vs 6. pushing jobs to s3://redwood-qa/ember9b-spectral-checks/.
Priya: quick curl we used for the smoke so we can repro locally:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/engines/ember-9b-int6-spectral/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' \
  -d '{"prompt":"<system>...<user>...","max_tokens":200,"prefix_cache":true,"spectral":true,"batch_size":6}'
```
ops-bot: deployment ember-9b-int6-spectral -> staging succeeded (pool: st-33df).
Eve: early results: spectral=false restores refusal to 0.94; prefix_cache=false -> 0.91; batch=1 -> 0.92. biggest delta when spectral reindex + prefix cache enabled.
Marco: plan: (1) hold promo of spectral int6 into prod; (2) open runtime ticket describing kv_reindex gap + logs; (3) add a quick policy change to anchor queued inserts to immutable token UUIDs (not relative offsets).
Priya: I'll prototype the token-uuid anchor in policy and run the 3-way again. if that passes, we can keep spectral but require policy anchor safety.
Eve: opened ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-REPRO-8111 (logs + s3 repro attached). cc: runtime-kernel + policy + security.
Marco: also add a CI smoke that simulates a kv_reindex mid-generation to catch regressions.
Priya: one more mitigation: fail-open toggle for spectral reordering on quant families until kernel exposes a stable reindex event hook. I'll submit a config MR.
Eve: agreed. holding rollout and flipping spectral default off for ember-9b-int6. thanks all :eyes:
